author: Sideprojects
description:
When disasters strike, they sometimes preserve history rather than destroy it. This episode explores fourteen catastrophic events—from Vesuvius burying Pompeii to Arctic ice entombing Franklin's ships—that accidentally created remarkable archaeological time capsules. Fires baked clay tablets hard, mudslides sealed wooden buildings, and shipwrecks protected precious Bronze Age cargo from recycling.
